title: Trade review 23 Nov: 7 results, 5 lessons
summary: 0 T2, 1 T1 (PERSISTENT +3.21%), 1 failed (GOODLUCK −7.91%); PNGSREVA and ASTRAL closed at a loss. 3 new buys.
body_md:
**Trade review, Mon 23 Nov:** PERSISTENT hit T1, 3 new buys, GOODLUCK failed, PNGSREVA and ASTRAL closed below their buy price.

A bad day for the closed list. Three 30-day exits cost −16.0 points, so all 93 closed trades now total +127.2% (average +1.4%), against +143.1% from 90 on Friday. Nifty fell 1.75% to 25,349.65. 18 trades are still running, 10 of them below their buy price, and the average of all 111 bought trades is +1.0%. No new picks were listed. The next 30-day exits are ONGC (−1.0%, T1 booked) on Wed 25 Nov and ESCORTS (−6.7%, T1 booked) on Fri 27 Nov; Tue 24 Nov is a market holiday.

**Today's results**
- ❌ **GOODLUCK** (Retest, listed 21 Oct): failed at 30 days: Bought at the zone top ₹574.09 on 22 Oct, best rise only +0.47%; closed at ₹528.70, −7.91% (worst −15.52%), 5.1% below its ₹557.37 support. The listing chart shows a jump of about 20% in one week on very heavy volume, straight up to the ₹615 wall and 52-week high. It then stalled just under that wall, with T2 (₹608.53) right below it, and listed on only 0.4× volume as buyers faded. It rose 12.0% in the month before listing, and it is a Retest, the setup taken off the list on 4 Nov. Zone bottom only would have softened it: bought at ₹557.37 on 23 Oct, it closes at −5.14%.
- ✅ **PNGSREVA** (Retest, listed 22 Oct): partial win, trade closed: T1 was reported on 28 Oct (₹644.75 → ₹683.22 in 5 days). The other half closed at the 30-day mark near ₹539.50, so the whole trade averages ₹611.36: −5.18% in 31 days (worst −17.18%). Counted as a partial win, but it lost money. It rose 28.5% in the month before listing and listed on 0.13× volume.
- ✅ **ASTRAL** (Candle at support, listed 22 Oct): partial win, trade closed: T1 was reported on 4 Nov (₹1,372.89 → ₹1,414.07 in 12 days). The other half closed near ₹1,252.59, so the whole trade averages ₹1,333.33: −2.88% in 31 days (worst −11.46%). A partial win that lost money, in a weakening sector.
- ✅ **PERSISTENT** (Retest, listed 2 Nov): T1 hit, still open: ₹6,087.30 → ₹6,269.92 in 20 days, after a worst dip of −5.25%; now +3.21% on a day Nifty fell 1.75%. An F&O stock in a leading sector, with T2 at ₹6,452.54. It traded 2.1% cheaper inside its entry window (₹5,963).
- 🟢 **NLCINDIA** (Candle at support, listed 20 Nov): bought: Filled at the zone top ₹233.04, 0.3% below the listing close; now −2.52%. It traded 2.9% cheaper today (₹226.50), near the zone bottom. Its 2 Nov listing closed at T2.
- 🟢 **PREMIERENE** (Candle at support, listed 20 Nov): bought: Filled at the open ₹838.00, inside the zone and 0.4% above the listing close; now −3.36%. It traded 3.9% cheaper today, and a zone-bottom buy at ₹822.95 also filled. Its 29 Oct listing closed at T2.
- 🟢 **LLOYDSENGG** (Pullback, listed 20 Nov): bought: Filled at the zone top ₹83.43, 0.3% below the listing close; now +0.78%. A cash stock in a lagging sector, listed on 0.6× volume.

PNGSREVA and ASTRAL closed today (partial wins that lost money); GOODLUCK's failure is not in this table. Plus 62 earlier. These 72 wins (55 at T2, 17 partial) made +345.5%; with the 21 failures (−218.3% in total, worst MANINDS −24.56%, MOTISONS −22.63% and SMLMAH −18.63%; four of them are liquid ETFs that closed flat) all 93 closed trades total +127.2%. 9 of the 17 partial 'wins' lost money. T1 booked, rest still open (7): PERSISTENT ₹6,087.30 → ₹6,269.92 in 20 days (today), UNIONBANK and INDIANB (20 Nov), GRANULES (12 Nov), LUPIN (9 Nov), ONGC (2 Nov) and ESCORTS (28 Oct). 3 of these 7 are below their buy price (ESCORTS −6.7%, ONGC −1.0%, INDIANB −0.1%).

**Missed and better entries**
- **Missed winners still 21 of 33:** None new tonight. 25 of the 33 never bought came within 2% of the zone. TECHM (listed 20 Nov) came within 1.1% of the zone top and is still waiting.
- **Better prices inside the window:** On a falling day all three new buys traded below their fill: PREMIERENE 3.9%, NLCINDIA 2.9% and LLOYDSENGG 0.5%. GOODLUCK is a case for buying lower: zone bottom only cut its loss from −7.9% to −5.1%.
- **Zone up to 2% higher: more fills, a little more money:** Fills 94% vs 80% as listed: 14.4 points (the bar is 15), slightly further than Friday. T1 hits 99 vs 75. Its 111 closed trades made +162.6%, against +127.2% from 93 as listed, with 27 losing trades against 26.
- **Next day's open: shallower dips and the most money:** Worst dip −6.0% vs −7.3% as listed, 1.3 points shallower (the bar is 2). Its 109 closed trades made +192.0% with 22 losing trades; average closed trade +1.8% against +1.4%.

**Lessons**
- **Retests fill almost always, but they lose money (now off the list):** Their 31 trades average −2.9% (closed and open), and their 26 closed trades net −81.7% with 12 of the 21 failures; GOODLUCK and PNGSREVA closed today at −7.9% and −5.2%. Off the list since 4 Nov. The 19 retest near misses logged since then: 6 at T1, 5 at T2, best rise 4.1% on average. (holding)
- **Stocks that ran up before listing fail most:** 14 of the 17 real failures rose 5% or more in the month before listing (GOODLUCK +12.0% today). Those 40 trades average −3.1% and their 34 closed trades net −119.5%; the other 71 made +246.6% from 59 closed trades, 42 at T2. Still my own 5% split, not a tracker group, so it cannot become a change. (holding)
- **Candle-at-support picks are the best group:** 39 of 49 bought reached T1 (80%) and 30 reached T2 (61%); their 37 closed trades made +169.1% with 4 failures, and they dip least (−3.9%). ASTRAL today is one of the few that lost money. (holding)
- **F&O stocks do far better than cash stocks:** 43 F&O trades: 28 at T2 (65%), worst dip −3.2%. 57 cash trades: 19 at T2 (33%), worst dip −11.3%. GOODLUCK and PNGSREVA, both cash stocks, closed at a loss today. (holding)
- **(missed) Support picks that never dip into the zone are often winners:** 21 of 33 never bought would have reached T1 at the next open; 25 of the 33 came within 2% of the zone. Those buys sit close to T1, so the wins are small. (holding)

**Second review for a tracker group:** picks with trigger volume under 1.5× reach T2 less often (41 of 88, 47%; worst dip −7.7%) than those at 1.5–2.5× (10 of 15, 67%; −3.7%). GOODLUCK (0.4×) and PNGSREVA (0.13×) fit it today. There is no fixed entry rule in the tracker that tests it, so it stays an early sign. Still true but out of the top 5: picks already in the buy zone at listing always fill (49 of 49).

**Proposed change:** No change tonight. Zone up to 2% above gets 14.4 points more fills against a bar of 15, with more T1 hits (99 vs 75). Buying at the next day's open is still the best rule on money (+192.0% vs +127.2%), but its dip gain is 1.3 points against a bar of 2.

**Bug check:** nothing found. 111 bought = 55 at T2 + 17 partial + 21 failed + 18 running; T1 hit 79 ≥ T2 hit 55; no dates out of order; no duplicates; every closed return matches its fill and exit, and no closed price, date or return changed. The only changes against Friday are the three new fills, PERSISTENT's T1 and the three 30-day exits.
